Did you know that 85% of small and medium-sized businesses find online customer feedback beneficial? Understanding your customers is crucial for the success of your small business. If you're wondering about the best questions to ask on a survey for a floral shop, you are in the right place! In this post, we’ll cover why you should use a floral shop survey to collect valuable information from your customers, top questions to ask with answers and also how to create your own in minutes using Formester. This will help you improve your services, meet customer needs, and stay ahead in the competitive floral industry. ## Why Use a Survey for a Floral Shop? Running a floral shop is not just about selling flowers. It is about bringing joy to customers. You must meet their expectations and stay ahead of the competition. A survey helps you connect with your customers and understand their preferences. It’s an easy way to gather feedback, improve your services, and even boost sales. For example, you can ask customers what types of bouquets they like or if they’d be interested in a subscription service. With their answers, you’ll know exactly what they want, so you can offer products and services that make them happy. ### Benefits of Surveys for Floral Shops: * Understand Customer Preferences: Learn their favorite flowers or arrangements. * Improve Customer Experience: Identify areas where you can do better, like delivery or packaging. * Improve Sales: Offer products or services based on customer needs. * Stay Competitive: Keep up with trends and what your competitors might be doing. ### 20 Questions and Answers for Your Floral Shop Survey Here’s a list of 20 questions and answers you can include in the survey for your floral shop: ### Section 1: Customer Profile How often do you buy flowers? * Once a week * Once a month * A few times a year * Rarely What occasions do you typically buy flowers for? (Select all that apply) * Birthdays * Anniversaries * Weddings * Funerals * Just because Where do you usually buy flowers? * Local floral shop * Online stores * Supermarkets * Street vendors What’s your age group? * Under 18 * 18–24 * 25–34 * 35–44 * 45 and above #### Section 2: Product and Service Feedback What’s your favorite type of flower or plant? (Open text field) What price range do you feel is reasonable for floral arrangements? * $20–$40 * $40–$60 * $60–$80 * Over $80 How satisfied are you with the variety of flowers we offer? * Very satisfied * Satisfied * Neutral * Dissatisfied * Very dissatisfied Have you tried our delivery service? * Yes (please rate below) * No If yes, how would you rate your delivery experience? * Excellent * Good * Average * Poor #### Section 3: Customer Experience How easy is it to navigate our store (physical or online)? * Very easy * Easy * Neutral * Difficult * Very difficult How likely are you to recommend us to friends or family? (Scale: 1 = Not likely, 10 = Very likely) Do you follow us on social media? * Yes * No * I didn’t know you had social media accounts What additional products or services would you like us to offer? (Open text field) #### Section 4: Future Improvements Would you be interested in a flower subscription service? * Yes * No * Maybe Would you attend floral workshops or events if we hosted them? * Yes * No What is one thing you think we could improve? (Open text field) #### Section 5: Customer Preferences How do you prefer to receive updates or promotions from us? * Email * Text message * Social media * In-store announcements Do you prefer fresh-cut flowers, potted plants, or both? * Fresh-cut flowers * Potted plants * Both What packaging styles do you prefer for your flowers? * Simple and minimalistic * Elegant and decorative * Eco-friendly #### Section 6: Feedback on Special Services Have you used our event flower services (e.g., weddings or corporate events)? * Yes (please rate your experience below) * No If yes, how was your experience? * Excellent * Good * Average * Poor Would you like to share a testimonial or review? Frequently asked questions

Common questions about running a customer feedback survey for a floral shop.

What questions should I ask in a floral shop customer survey?
Cover 5 categories: customer experience (greeting, store cleanliness), product quality (freshness, arrangement, packaging), pricing (perceived value), delivery (on-time rate, condition), and loyalty (repeat visits, NPS). Aim for 15-20 questions total.
How long should a floral shop survey be?
5 to 10 minutes. 15-20 questions. Past 10 minutes, completion rate drops below 50%. Use a mix of yes/no, linear scale, and 1 or 2 short-text questions.
When is the best time to send a floral shop survey?
Within 24 hours of purchase or delivery, while the experience is fresh. For wedding or event arrangements, send 3-5 days after the event so the customer has seen how the flowers held up.
How many responses do I need for a floral shop survey to be useful?
30 responses give you a rough read on trends. 100 responses give statistically meaningful comparisons by store, day, or product line.
Should I offer an incentive for a floral shop survey?
Yes if response rate is low. A 10% discount on the next purchase or a free single-stem bouquet works. Avoid cash incentives, they attract low-quality responses.
What's a good NPS score for a floral shop?
Above 50 is excellent. 30-50 is good. 0-30 is average. Below 0 means most customers are detractors and you have urgent service issues to fix.
How do I survey wedding and event customers vs walk-in customers?
Use two different surveys. Walk-in customers care about freshness, pricing, and store experience. Wedding customers care about responsiveness, design approval process, day-of delivery, and final product matching the vision.
What linear-scale labels work best for floral surveys?
1-5 with labels 'Very dissatisfied / Dissatisfied / Neutral / Satisfied / Very satisfied' works for product quality. NPS uses 0-10 with 'Not at all likely / Extremely likely' to recommend.
Can I send the floral shop survey by SMS?
Yes. Send the survey link in a text after the purchase. Texts have higher open rates than email (98% vs 25%), but customers may resist long forms on mobile, keep mobile surveys under 8 questions.
Is there a free template for a floral shop survey?
Yes. Formester's floral and small-business templates include pre-built surveys with the 20 questions above. Free to use, customize, and embed on your floral shop website or share via SMS.
